Compute Match — Local Development Guide
Prerequisites
Git, Bash, Make, Docker Desktop with Compose v2, and NVIDIA network/VPN access.
Either Devbox 0.18.3 or newer (supplies all tools) or installed tools: Node 22 (frontend), Python 3.13 and uv (backend and worker).
Docker-only mode (make onboard, make start) needs no Node or Python on your laptop.
First run
make onboard      # build containers, prepare databases and identity, create demo accounts and inventory
make verify       # should finish with "status": "ready"
The first build can take 10–20 minutes. Without Make, run ./local-setup/onboard.sh. If it fails, read local-setup/.onboarding/setup.log, fix the problem and rerun.
Open http://localhost:3000, click Login, enter a demo account email, then its generated password.
Demo accounts
Passwords are generated into local-setup/.onboarding/accounts.md (human guide) and credentials.json (machine-readable, includes the Keycloak admin login). These files are Git-ignored.
Experience Account Customer developer@customer-a.example.org Provider (NCP) seed@singtel.example.org Platform business admin business-admin@platform.example.org Operations ops@platform.example.org
Normal onboarding creates 17 accounts; Singtel and Firmus provider accounts test isolation between NCPs, and colleague accounts test shared inventory inside one NCP. make onboard ONBOARD_ARGS="--with-scenarios" adds 22-account regression personas, including pending@scenarios.example.org (pending activation), terms@scenarios.example.org (terms not accepted), restricted@scenarios.example.org (active, no business role), infra-manager@customer-a.example.org and tech-admin@customer-b.example.org.
Test sign-ups with addresses such as you@example.com; example.com and nvidia.com auto-activate, personal domains are blocked, and local email delivery is disabled. A new sign-up may need a role assigned in Keycloak (customer realm → user → Role mapping), then sign out and in again.
make onboard ONBOARD_ARGS="--no-seed" creates accounts without demo inventory. Sample CSVs for upload testing are in local-setup/fixtures/.
Development modes
Command Runs on your laptop Runs in Docker make start nothing frontend, backend, worker make frontend frontend backend, worker make backend backend frontend, worker make worker worker frontend, backend make dev (fullstack) all three none
PostgreSQL, Keycloak, Temporal and Redis always stay in Docker. Install dependencies for a mode with make deps MODE=backend (or frontend, worker).
Make targets
Target Purpose make help List commands make onboard Configure, start and seed (ONBOARD_ARGS for options) make doctor Check prerequisites and configuration only make deps Install locked dependencies for a MODE make build Build local images make start / make stop Start all in Docker / stop everything but keep data make start-infra Start only supporting containers make status Show mode, processes and URLs make logs SERVICE=backend Follow logs (frontend, backend or worker) make verify Check accounts, permissions, inventory, login routing and worker polling make test, make test-backend, make test-frontend, … Unit tests make quality Lint, type checks and tests make clean Remove containers, volumes and images make obs-start / obs-stop / obs-logs Optional SigNoz telemetry stack
Local URLs and ports
Service Address Application http://localhost:3000 Backend API docs (Swagger) http://localhost:8082/docs Keycloak http://localhost:8080 (admin at /admin, realm customer) Temporal UI http://localhost:7600 Temporal gRPC localhost:7233 PostgreSQL localhost:5432 Redis localhost:6379 Superset (optional) http://localhost:8088 SigNoz (optional) http://localhost:3301 (OTLP gRPC 4317, HTTP 4318)
Configuration files
Location Use local-setup/.env Generated service settings and secrets local-setup/.onboarding/credentials.json Account credentials local-setup/.onboarding/accounts.md Account guide local-setup/.onboarding/dev/ Host-mode settings, process state and logs local-setup/.onboarding/setup.log Onboarding diagnostics
You do not need to copy .env.sample or create service dotenv files.
Everyday loop
make stop at the end of the day keeps your data; make start resumes. Use make status, then make logs SERVICE=... when something looks wrong.
Common problems
Problem Fix Image or Maven downloads fail Connect to the NVIDIA VPN Port already in use Stop the other checkout or process using the port Wrong Node version Use Node 22 or set LOCAL_DEV_NODE Login redirects to a Docker hostname Restore localhost public URLs in the generated settings Signed up but see no features Assign a realm role in Keycloak and sign in again SigNoz shows no data Finish SigNoz first-user setup, run make obs-start, restart apps with tracing; Docker Engine 25+ for container metrics Everything is broken make clean && make onboard && make verify
